title: Kanboard Plugin: Draw.io Integration
summary: Embeds diagrams.net into Kanboard tasks and projects, so system architecture diagrams are created, edited, and stored beside the tasks they document.

title: Kanboard Plugin: File Attachment Interaction
summary: Streamlines task document management by adding in-place file previews and shortening the path between Kanban boards and technical attachments.

title: Custom YOLOv8 Model for Number Detection on Meters
summary: Automates digit reading from utility meter photographs, serving trained weights through a containerized FastAPI REST service and a Hugging Face Gradio space.

title: Image Colorization with Deep Learning
summary: Reconstructs plausible color for grayscale images across four progressive notebook models (from baseline convolutional networks to adversarial GANs) to evaluate structural and color fidelity.
